description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractGrant' representing a generic OAuth 2.0 authorization grant. It specifies the structure and common behaviors for concrete grant types, including methods for retrieving grant names, preparing request parameters, and string representation.

classes.name: AbstractGrant
classes.description: An abstract representation of an OAuth 2.0 authorization grant, providing common functionality for different grant types.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the name of the grant type, used as the grant identifier.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Abstract method to specify all required parameters for the request.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the grant's name as its string representation, useful for URL building.

methods.name: prepareRequestParameters
methods.description: Prepares and validates the request parameters for obtaining an access token, merging default parameters with options and ensuring all required parameters are present.
